scope-boundary: Change: channel and deployment answer capture (attribution, closing question, consent, screener, quota, reminders, adaptive setting), survey re-sync idempotence, CSV raw-data export, reliability matrix on normalised primary_code, report export (Markdown, DOCX, CSV), UI defects found in the menu walk, release-workflow failure handling, Homebrew/VERSION drift. Unchanged: the Research Spine gates (coding, reliability, reconciliation, Done, report), public route shapes except additive fields, stored metrics of past coding runs.
verification-bar: Each behaviour change has a test that fails on main first and passes after (pytest on the Studio in istara-test:1 with --network none); UI changes have a Playwright scenario step on the QA ui lane; model-dependent criteria run live with the three identities under $1 per run; verdicts follow the pre-registered criteria (DEC-2, DEC-3) in docs/build-stream/2026-09-26-professional-readiness-review.md.
rollback: Each phase is its own PR; revert the PR. Consent/screener/quota are per-deployment settings; the reliability change is a documented methodology fix and past runs keep their stored metrics.
docs: Tech.md, feature docs (scripts/feature_docs.py --generate-site --check), TESTING.md, testing/TEST_HISTORY.md, personas when agent-facing behaviour changes, docs/architecture/retrieval-graph-agentic-map.html, the lifecycle file.
